0022600215.text: The Orlando Magic (2-7, 12th in the East, 3.5 games back in the Southeast, 0-4 at home and 2-3 on the road) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-9, 14th in the West, 8 games back in the Pacific, 0-5 at home and 1-4 on the road) for the 10th game of the season for the Magic, with Orlando on a four-game losing streak and Sacramento on three straight losses. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), while Tristan da Silva is day-to-day with a calf strain and is a game-time decision, and Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), with Domantas Sabonis (knee soreness) and Keegan Murray (wrist soreness) both day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, while the Magic won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 121-117 win in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
